verdict.rationale: Structured interview scorecards are a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the pack has no evidence of them: nothing on defined attributes per stage, per-interviewer rubrics, or cross-candidate scorecard comparison. The only related items are an API endpoint that 'creates a rating for a candidate' and a pipeline stages endpoint. A generic candidate rating is an adjacent feature, not a structured scorecard, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates
